name: Life OS - Slack Resource Inbox Adapter

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  raw_input: $json.content,
  normalized_input: $json.content,
  content: $json.content,
  source_type: 'slack_resource_inbox',
  source_url: $json.primary_url,
  title: ($json.content || 'Slack resource').split('\n')[0].slice(0, 160),
  type: 'resource',
  deduplication_key: $json.deduplication_key,
  source_metadata: $json.source_metadata
}) }}
